note: Typed questions the superloop asks a decision model. Authority shadow means logged only. Authority brake means a qualified answer may pause the run, stop it for no progress or add a review, in advisory mode only. Authority smoke means it may only add review seats. No question can end a run as a success, skip a check, change the profile or approve an action. Thresholds live in qualification records, not here.

questions.instructions: Which situation in the model-mesh orchestration matrix best describes this goal?

criteria.unknown: None of the situations fits, or the goal is too unclear to place

questions.use: Logged against the owner's declared situation. Never changes the assignment.

questions.instructions: What does the latest batch show about progress toward the acceptance criteria?

criteria.stalled: No new evidence that any acceptance criterion is closer to passing since the last batch
criteria.regressing: A check that passed before now fails
criteria.drifting: The work is moving away from the stated objective or outside its scope
criteria.progressing: New evidence shows at least one acceptance criterion closer to passing

questions.use: Brake only. The conservative options come first so that a bias toward the first option errs toward stopping.

questions.instructions: Is the work blocked by something only a person can resolve, such as a missing credential, a contradictory requirement or a check that cannot pass as written?

criteria.true: A person must act before the work can continue
criteria.false: The workers can keep going without a person

questions.use: Brake only. A false yes costs one look from a person.

questions.instructions: Would the next step need an action outside the approved scope: an irreversible change, a disclosure of data, a payment or a permission change?

criteria.true: The next step needs approval that the goal does not give
criteria.false: The next step stays inside the approved scope

questions.use: Brake only. The superloop has no approval path: the worker prompt forbids irreversible, outward, paid and permission-changing actions, and a yes here can only pause the run for a person.

questions.instructions: Do the facts show that every acceptance criterion is met?

criteria.true: Every acceptance criterion is met by the facts shown
criteria.false: At least one acceptance criterion is not shown as met

questions.use: Smoke detector. When the checks pass but this is low, every independent reviewer seat runs. It can never end the loop.

criteria.repair: Fix the checks that fail now
criteria.continue: Work on the next unmet acceptance criterion
criteria.request_review: The change looks ready for an independent review

questions.use: Logged only, to compare with the controller's own choice.
